ggbscript:
A = (-1, 0)
ShowLabel[A, true]
SetVisibleInView[A, 1, true]
SetColor[A, "#0000ff"]
SetLabelMode[A, 0]
SetPointSize[A, 3]

B = (1, 0)
ShowLabel[B, true]
SetVisibleInView[B, 1, true]
SetColor[B, "#0000ff"]
SetLabelMode[B, 0]
SetPointSize[B, 3]

c = Slider[-5, 5, 0.1, 2, 100, true, true, true]
SetValue[c, -4.8]
SetLineThickness[c, 2]
ShowLabel[c, true]
SetVisibleInView[c, 1, true]
SetFilling[c, 0.1]
SetLabelMode[c, 1]

X = (x(A), c)
ShowLabel[X, true]
SetVisibleInView[X, 1, true]
SetColor[X, "#444444"]
SetLabelMode[X, 0]
SetPointSize[X, 3]

Y = (x(B), (2 * c^(2)))
ShowLabel[Y, true]
SetVisibleInView[Y, 1, true]
SetColor[Y, "#0000ff"]
SetLabelMode[Y, 0]
SetPointSize[Y, 3]

text1 = Text["x=" + c + ""]
ShowLabel[text1, false]
SetVisibleInView[text1, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text1, 0]

d = Segment[X,Y]
ShowLabel[d, false]
SetVisibleInView[d, 1, true]
SetColor[d, "#ff33cc"]
SetLabelMode[d, 0]
SetLineThickness[d, 2]

a : 1 x + 0 y + 1 = 0
ShowLabel[a, false]
SetVisibleInView[a, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[a, 0]
SetLineThickness[a, 2]

b : 1 x + 0 y + -1 = 0
ShowLabel[b, false]
SetVisibleInView[b, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[b, 0]
SetLineThickness[b, 2]

text2 = Text["y=" + (y(Y)) + ""]
ShowLabel[text2, false]
SetVisibleInView[text2, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text2, 0]
